sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch last-swing rebased onto the fleet sha at launch (deathfix-01 goes first)
notes: 61 OF 80 BOTS COULD NOT MAKE STONE. They held only pickaxes at 1 use, and gather's reserve refused to spend the last use, so no cobblestone -> no stone_pickaxe. In the 3 h to 2026-09-29 04:45Z, 227 of 281 stone_pickaxe craft rows were 'cannot craft stone_pickaxe -- gather cobblestone'. THE CHANGE (c63c847 + b1c978e): gather may spend a pickaxe's LAST use, on the stone family only (stone, cobblestone, deepslate, cobbled_deepslate, blackstone), and only when the held tool is confirmed equipped (else equip_failed, 0 digs). `_last_swing` is written after the block is confirmed broken, with a snapshot. Reviewed by Claude and Codex independently; both guards mutant-killed; 204/204. SANDBOX Paper 1.21.11: 3x `_last_swing` 'broke stone ... at 1 use(s)', 'collected 3 cobblestone', 'crafted 1x stone_pickaxe'. WHY THE GATE IS CORRECTNESS: the change is deterministic; the fleet question is whether it ran, only on stone, and harmed nothing. The effect lines are reported (DiD vs the same-length pre-window) and do not gate.

licence.note: The baseline has no `_last_swing` row kind (git grep last_swing 80b3bbd -- bots/src: 0). ~3 'gather cobblestone' craft failures per bot per 3 h in control, so a 5-bot canary that contains the population should write several within 3 h.

require.name: bots failing a stone_pickaxe for want of cobblestone (the population this fix targets)

draw_exposure.note: CLAUDE.md: a canary pool must contain the population the fix targets. Fleet-wide 225 such rows in 3 h on 75 bots (dry run 2026-09-29 04:50Z).

exposure.note: Ready = at least one canary-build `_last_swing` (the fix ran) AND at least one control 'gather cobblestone' failure (the population query sees a presence).

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS. A last swing on anything outside the stone family burns the copy that buys a new pickaxe. Deterministic.
The baseline cannot write `_last_swing`; a control row means the arms are wrong. No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS. Zero means the branch never ran on the fleet. No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE), never reverts.
POSITIVE CONTROL for the population query (225 in the 3 h dry run). No evidence class: BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: DiD in the share of bots whose latest snapshot holds a pickaxe with >= 2 uses; also crafted_did_per_bh (stone_pickaxe crafts) and short_did_per_bh ('gather cobblestone' failures, expected to fall). Dry run on the unchanged fleet (hive-c, 3 h) gave usable_share_did +0.147 on 5 bots -- the noise on one pool is that large, so this cannot decide anything on its own.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.
